_comment: Links of the Ilal data decided by hand (link_ilal.py). mudallisin: by entry number in طبقات المدلسين; mukhtalitun: by the merged record's name. id null = not in the registry. From the review of all 174 mudallisin links (review/mudallisin_review.json, Sonnet first pass, checked by hand). students: by «mukhtalit name|student name» as in the hearing record (review/mukhtalitun_review.json, Sonnet first pass, every non-right item checked by hand).
